# Travel Policy

**Document title:** Travel Policy
**Version:** 1.2
**Applies to:** All employees travelling on company business
**Owner:** Finance

## 1. Purpose

This policy sets out how business travel is approved, booked and reimbursed.

## 2. Booking and approval

### 2.1 Domestic travel

Domestic flights must be booked through the company travel desk at least 14 days before the travel date. Bookings made later need written approval from the department head.

### 2.2 International travel

International trips need approval from the employee's manager and the Finance controller. Requests must be raised at least 30 days before departure.

## 3. Flight class and daily allowance

| Band | Flight class | Daily allowance (domestic) | Daily allowance (international) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Band A, Band B | Economy | ₹2,500 | US$60 |
| Band C | Economy | ₹3,500 | US$80 |
| Band D and above | Premium economy | ₹5,000 | US$110 |

The daily allowance covers meals and local transport. Hotel stays are paid directly by the travel desk.

## 4. Expenses that are not reimbursed

Alcohol, minibar charges and in-flight entertainment are **not** reimbursable. Fines for traffic or parking violations are also not reimbursed.

## 5. Visas and immigration

Visa, work permit and immigration requirements are defined in the Global Mobility Policy, not in this document.

## 6. Claims

Expense claims must be submitted within 15 days of returning, with original receipts.
